Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement. On October 13, 2026, Elk Creek Resources Corp. (“ ECRC ”), a majority-owned subsidiary of NioCorp Developments Ltd. (the “ Company ”), entered into an Offtake Agreement (the “ Offtake Agreement ”) with Traxys North America LLC (“ Traxys ”) covering ferroniobium and certain other products expected to be produced at the Company’s Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project in southeast Nebraska (the “ Elk Creek Project ”), including scandium, titanium and rare earth products. The Offtake Agreement supersedes and replaces the prior ferroniobium and scandium offtake agreements between the Company and Traxys, including the ferroniobium offtake agreement originally entered into on June 13, 2016, as amended and as assigned to Traxys (the “ Prior Ferroniobium Offtake Agreement ”). Pursuant to the terms of the Offtake Agreement, and subject to certain exclusions, Traxys will purchase, on a take-or-pay basis, 50% of the Elk Creek Project's annual ferroniobium production or, at Traxys’ election, 3,700 metric tonnes of ferroniobium per year, and will have a right of first refusal on certain additional ferroniobium production. In addition, Traxys will have the exclusive right, but not the obligation, to market and sell 100% of the Elk Creek Project’s products other than ferroniobium, including scandium oxide, scandium metal and scandium-aluminum master alloy, titanium tetrachloride, neodymium-praseodymium oxide, dysprosium oxide, terbium oxide, samarium-europium-gadolinium carbonate, and heavy rare earth carbonate, and derivatives thereof (collectively, the “ Other Products ” and, collectively with ferroniobium, the “ Products ”). Ferroniobium will be priced by reference to a published monthly market price for ferroniobium, less a discount that increases at five-year intervals over the term. The Other Products will be priced by reference to published market prices, or, for Other Products without a published price assessment, the gross price invoiced by Traxys to third-party purchasers in bona fide arm’s length sales, in each case, less a marketing commission payable to Traxys and less certain of Traxys' actual logistics, marketing and financing costs. Traxys will also have the exclusive right to sell the Products worldwide, except that, for ferroniobium, the European Union is excluded while the Company’s existing ferroniobium offtake agreement with Thyssen Krupp Metallurgical Products GmbH remains in effect, subject to certain exceptions and exclusions. The Offtake Agreement has a term of 15 years measured from the first day of the month during which the output of the Products over the three prior calendar months equals or exceeds 80% of the planned production of the Products at the Elk Creek Project on an annualized basis (the “ Commercial Production Date ”).
